s050: Use your gun’s desktop software to select absolute mouse mode and calibrate it to this monitor. Map the trigger to left click, reload or pedal to the selected mouse button (or Space), credits to 5, and start to Enter. Use Fullscreen here; the game keeps its original proportions.
s051: Sinden: keep its tracking software running and enable the white border here in fullscreen. Gun4IR, AimTrak, Retro Shooter and similar guns can use this input path when configured to move the system mouse. Do not use relative / air-mouse mode. If aiming off-screen leaves the pointer frozen, use the reload button to take cover.
s052: One screen pointer per browser. For TC2 co-op, use two devices and an online room. Device software, calibration and recoil are managed outside this website. USB drivers and raw joystick-only modes are not provided. Physical lightguns have not yet been tested with this port.
s055: Host as Keith. Join as Robert. Rooms and voice run through this website’s own server.

s073: P1 starts SOLO/LINKED. P2’s cabinet restarts once, then the trigger joins LINK PLAY. P2 waits until P1 has played for 25 seconds. While linked, opening the menu keeps the game running.

s106: For Virtual Desktop, connect the headset to your PC, then open this address in the PC's Chrome or Edge browser. Use VDXR or SteamVR as its active OpenXR runtime. Click Load game, then Enter VR and accept the browser's VR request. For standalone Quest, open the HTTPS site in the headset browser.
s109: Trigger: fire / start. Hold either grip to leave cover; release to hide and reload. Lower face button on your preferred hand, or right stick/trackpad click: credit. Upper face button: aiming feedback. The opposite lower button recenters.
s112: Open the VR menu with left stick click or the opposite hand’s upper button. In all three games, point and pull the trigger, or use sticks and face buttons; grips switch tabs. TC2 push-to-talk: use the opposite upper button for the menu. Desktop: Esc opens the menu; use the mouse, arrow keys, Enter and Tab.
s113: Headset detection updates when devices connect or you return to the page. Check headset retries detection; Enter VR attempts a connection even if an earlier check found no headset. Other headsets require immersive WebXR and tracked controllers. The browser chooses the display rate; 120 Hz is not guaranteed.
s114: The language selection changes this website. Original game menus and audio keep their original language.
s116: Cabinet progress is saved locally in this browser. Clearing site data removes it. Settings and saves are separate from the native Quest and Windows apps.
